hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "\-\-no-verify"; then echo "BLOCKED: --no-verify flag detected. Commit hooks exist for a reason."; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git push"; then echo "REMINDER: Have you run /review and /cso before pushing?"; fi'
hooks.description: Remind to review and security-check before pushing

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "\.(md|txt|rst)$"; then echo "NOTE: Modifying documentation file. Ensure it stays consistent with CLAUDE.md and other project docs."; fi'
